LESSON: THE CONQUEST OF MAKKAH HUNAYN

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.3: The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What lessons do Muslims learn from the events of fat- hul Makkah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the events that led to the conquest of Makkah for spiritual nourishment
2. state the reasons that led to the battle of Hunayn
3. explain the effects of the battle of Hunayn to strengthen their Iman
4. apply the lessons from the conquest of Makkah in day-to- day life
5. appreciate clemency as part of the Sunnah of the prophet (S.A.W.). resolving conflicts from the events of fat-hul Makkah

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE CONQUEST OF MAKKAH HUNAYN
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

PART 1: Describe the events that led to the conquest of Makkah for spiritual nourishment

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the events that led to the conquest of Makkah for spiritual nourishment. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the events that led to the conquest of Makkah for spiritual nourishment.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe the events that led to the conquest of Makkah for spiritual nourishment)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn in your own words. (skill: state the reasons that led to the battle of Hunayn)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: explain the effects of the battle of Hunayn to strengthen their Iman)

Example 4: Show how “The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply the lessons from the conquest of Makkah in day-to- day life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the events that led to the conquest of Makkah for spiritual nourishment.
3. Practise this skill: state the reasons that led to the battle of Hunayn.
4. Practise this skill: explain the effects of the battle of Hunayn to strengthen their Iman.
5. Make one local Kenya example of The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What lessons do Muslims learn from the events of fat- hul Makkah?
2. Why should one forgive people who have wronged them?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the events that led to the conquest of Makkah for spiritual nourishment.
5. Be able to: state the reasons that led to the battle of Hunayn.
